result.reason: The clause does not require Customer Data to be returned in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days or require certified deletion thereafter, so it fails both the preferred and fallback data-export positions. It also exceeds the required transition period by providing 12 months rather than up to six months (or the 90-day fallback), and unnecessarily adds no-charge assistance for breach, restrictions concerning disputed amounts and releases, and rights during the term. Drafting defects include the duplicated section number and an imprecise reference to the “transition period.”
